reviews.x: I had bought a glass nail file that I loved and expected these to be the same, as they look the same in the pictures.  The price for 5 was too good to pass up.  I was a little disappointed in that the edges on these are not tapered like the other file so they don't fit as easily behind nails.  They still do a good job of getting a clean, smooth finish, but are just more awkward and cumbersome to use.  Also they are a bit bulky for the cases and have to be pushed hard to get them in, rubbing the

reviews.t: Not bad, but not quite Czech glass
reviews.x: The filing surface on these files is etched, not glued on, so they are better than the average glass file from China. They come with nice hard plastic cases to protect the files from breaking in your purse or bag. They work fine for filing and shaping your nails, but they are not quite the quality of the Czech glass files that are available. When filing my nails, it felt like the file dragged a little more and just wasn't quite as smooth as my Czech glass. However, these are more than adequate,
very nice case, but file is a bit too smooth....could use a bit more grit to make filing faster

reviews.t: love these!  Every bit as good as the more expensive ones...
reviews.x: I was skeptical since these were so inexpensive... I bought some other "glass files" on Amazon that cost quite a bit more but these are exactly the same... I can't tell them apart aside from the color and writing...  I can see how they might break if dropped but that's the case with any of these files... I'm never going back to nasty cardboard files again!  You can wash these and they last forever!

Excellent quality nail files!  I use it to shape my nails to play the guitar.  I've tried several such crystal glass file sets.  Many of them work well but I end up breaking them easily after storing them in a toiletry case.  The best thing about these is that each of the files is enclosed in an individual case that's solid and prevents them from taking any load and breaking.  Thoughtful design..

Best nail files ever! I have been a many decades long nail biter & am also hard on my hands in general. The thing that bugs me most is ragged edges & I've never found a file that truly smoothes out the edges to my OCD liking until now. They are well made & yes they're fragile but I am careful to keep them in their holders when not in use. Very, very pleased & I have fingernails now☺.

reviews.t: This product is advertised as Czech nail filer. On ...
reviews.x: This product is advertised as Czech nail filer. On the packaging, however, it states made in China. I find this misleading. There is no other marking of origin of the product, so I assume the whole product is made in China. I have nothing against China, but if you are advertising a Czech product, should it not say Made in the Czech Republic?
Cheaply made! Not happy with this purchase. They are very thick and hard to use. I recommend Nail Tek crystal files.

reviews.t: Great files, but case needs to be replaced
reviews.x: These are exactly what you would expect them to be as far as quality. The files are thick and has a very nice even grit to both sides with a polished colored handle. My nails have been strong and I haven’t had any nails splinter since I purchased these. The case is what it looks like in the picture, kind of cheap and flimsy, but I didn’t purchaseit for the case I just make sure to put it in my cosmetic bag before throwing into the black hole that is my purse.
Not as good as others available on Amazon. Not the quality I was looking for.  I bought one glass nail file from bonafide beauty and it is hands down superior. Would not buy these again.

I heard these break easy to I bought the file with a holder. They are attractive. The first time a viewed it, I thought these are thick (not a problem). Well, I've had thin flimsy nails all my life and several nails that always chipped and just would not maintain a nice contour. After using these once, I could tell a difference. after 1 week the nicks in my nails started to grow out and after two weeks I am totally stunned at my nail transformation. I am going to by several more sets for friends

These are the lowest quality glass files I've ever encountered and I've purchased a few.  Very scratchy, not smooth at all.  No quality sticker.  Not pleasant to even hold they are so rough and also very difficult to pull out of the case because--you guessed it--very jagged surface.  Don't bother.

reviews.t: Beautiful rainbow set of glass nail files!
reviews.x: I've been wanting to try the glass nail files now for several years.  The cost of them was always a deterrent until I found this great 5 piece value set.  I was so excited to get them and try them out. I was so tired of buying  nail files over and over again only to have them break or bend in my purse or just wear out after a month or two. I wanted to invest in something that would last a little bit longer even if it was more than the usual dollar store Emery boards I've become so frustrated wit

I bought this from China glass nail file and the Czech glass nail file to compare.  The Czech glass one seemed to work better.  But the China ones comes with a nice case.  Nail file was ok... so depends on what is more important to you.  Better case ok file, or better file and have to buy a better protective case to put it in.  The cost difference was close (so maybe paying more for a nice case).  So I chose to go with the nicer nail file and bought a plastic test tube to put it in.  Works great

reviews.t: You Get What You Pay For
reviews.x: I bought these based on reviews. After years of owning pricey Czech glass files, I bought these to replace one I lost. After using these for a couple of  weeks, the quality, or lack thereof, began to show. It became almost smooth--and useless. Who cares if you get five if they go south in a matter of weeks. I ordered the genuine article, and immediately noticed the difference. I’m sure the replacement will last years unless I drop it on concrete.

reviews.t: UPDATE: Best way to keep healthy nails
reviews.x: UPDATE: I received the new improved nail file. The edges are wonderful and fit comfortably under the sides of your nail. I love the glass nail files. Easy to keep clean and If you've researched nail care you will find that glass nail files leave the smoothest edges without damaging the nail. You can feel the difference.

Excellent quality and bonus that they are all in individual cases making it handy to pop one in your bag. Work a treat with nail wraps giving a clean finish. There is a clear part of the file where you hold it the rest is the toughened glass. I would recommend this seller.

reviews.t: ... gifts and everyone that I gave one to really liked them. They do a nice job of filing ...
reviews.x: I purchased them as gifts and everyone that I gave one to really liked them.  They do a nice job of filing and I think it will hold up well.  They also came with a solid case to protect them when not in use, so could for carrying in a purse.

Nope. Nope. While they look nice, these are terrible for your nails. They barely accomplish anything, and rip and yank at the fibers in your nail. To be fair, they're made to be a cheap batch product, but overall, it's not really worth it.

*updated review* The company reached out to me a long time after I left this review to refund me for these subpar nail files. I was surprised since it was at least a full year since I had left the review. They did issue me a full refund so they get another star for good, but late customer service. But seeing how the review is really more for the item, not a company's customer service, I will not give this item more than 3 stars. Don't buy these nail files in the first place and you won't need go

reviews.t: Handy glass nail files - perfect as gifts
reviews.x: I've never used glass nail files before. I've used emery boards for years but my nails are thin and brittle and the emery boards tend to leave ragged edges.  I like these 5 9/16" long Czech glass files. Not only do they work well but they are pretty. I received five files - pink, red, blue, yellow and green. And they all came with a separate silver-colored carrying case - necessary since they are made of glass and are breakable.  Not only do I like these files but they make perfect gifts. Th

These are awesome!  I love this file.  It truly makes your nails look nice and prevents peeling, breakage, etc.  The price is excellent and the case is really the bonus.  I bought 2 sets of these and going to give all my lady friends one for Christmas. (Note, don't know how many have guys in their world that may need to have well manicured nails, but if you do, they would love these also).  Totally recommend!

reviews.t: These are not made in the Czech Republic. Very cheap. We get what we pay for.
reviews.x: These files are made in China. I thought they were the Czech Republic files. They were cheap so I will keep them but disappointed. Once you take the file out of the the holder it's difficult to put it back into the sleeve. So we'll probably just throw that part away. I would rather have had just the plastic containers.

Really nice crystal nail files in nice metal cases to help protect the files.  These files do break easily if dropped so the cases are a nice extra feature.  I recommend these.  The price is awesome, as well.  They make great little add on gifts and you get 5 of them!

reviews.t: These are great! Love the colors and the case
reviews.x: These are great!  Love the colors and the case.  They are a bit thicker than others I have had, however they do the job.  And, you get 5 -- great price.

claims.text: Many reviewers find these files good quality and a great value, often comparing them favorably to more expensive glass files.
Several reviewers note the files are fragile and can break if dropped, though the included hard plastic cases help protect them.
Some reviewers find the filing surface too smooth or lacking grit, making filing slower or becoming useless over time.
A few reviewers question the quality or origin, noting the product is advertised as Czech but marked made in China or inferior to Czech glass files.
Some reviewers find the files too thick, rough, or jagged, making them hard to use or remove from the case.
